evidenceNotes: Numbers re-audit 2026-10-12: Instagram Professional Insights Sep 12–Oct 11 = 20.0K views, 0 new followers, 58 content shared. /live Instagram inventory remains a 37-Reel lifetime sum (18,460), a different metric. Instagram Door inventory corrected from 979 to 1,544. Campaign-added headline is now 8,945; do not compare it to Insights 20.0K.
Lifetime goal: 250,000 overall reported video views by December 31 Eastern. Known total 153,397 after Door Instagram correction; historical coverage is not campaign growth.

96 public measured records plus seven private/unlisted YouTube records in aggregate: 103 measured posts. Focused updates cover four YouTube Shorts, five TikTok posts and four Instagram Reels. X is excluded from headline totals. Other inventory dates remain unchanged.

Focused native observations at 00:07-00:08 UTC on October 12 updated thirteen public posts. Full inventory observations remain dated around 19:49-19:52 UTC on October 11; component times stay separate.

The saved partial campaign total rose by 4,427: 1,678 net counter change on previously measured posts plus 2,749 newly included cumulative views from three Instagram posts. Those initial counters cover time since publication, not only the interval since the previous update. Other counters retain their earlier dates; no full inventory refresh, unique-audience or distribution-attribution claim.

The fixed opening baseline is 14,895 YouTube Shorts views and 13,337 Instagram Reel views, measured at 2:51-2:53 AM Eastern. The 23-minute start-to-baseline gap remains unmeasured. Negative native corrections are retained.

Anubis is verified public on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and Ko-fi. Lab File 003 is public on YouTube. The common planned release was 12:05 PM Eastern; native precision and processing vary. Ko-fi shows only a date, so its exact publication time is unknown.
Ko-fi Anubis remains a historical publication record; no additional Ko-fi posts are scheduled. Planned times are not actual publication times.

Owned Twitch, FACEIT and OBS source indexing remains incomplete. Editing approval used documented sampled visual and technical audio checks; unavailable listening or continuous playback is not claimed. Local operations require this PC online with Codex open.

All four launch teasers have native identities. X was published at 20:45:48 UTC; YouTube at 20:48:45 UTC. TikTok shows the 20:48 UTC creation minute with Everyone visibility; precise delivery time is unmeasured. Instagram exact publication time is unknown. YouTube, TikTok and Instagram teaser counters are included with their separate October 12 00:07-00:08 UTC observations; X is excluded.

Five Anubis and episode four-hour reviews and four Knife four-hour reviews are complete, all inconclusive. Their 24/72/168-hour checks remain. Knife reviews were observed October 12 at 00:07-00:08 UTC. Ko-fi exact publication time remains unavailable and has a separate observation review.

Instagram followers remain the dated 73 observation. Retention and engagement findings are shown in the review log with their own timestamps. Unknown counters are not zero; X views remain outside headline growth.

Door publication verified October 11: YouTube at 22:00:50 UTC, X at 22:00:52 UTC, Instagram at 22:01:04 UTC. TikTok shows the 22:00 UTC native creation minute with Everyone visibility; exact public-delivery instant is unmeasured. YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Door counters were observed at 00:07-00:08 UTC on October 12; X is excluded.

Current publishing allocation: 17 occupied + 0 reserved of 17, reconciled 2026-10-12T01:34:36.939286Z. 0 confirmed future platform posts; 0 reservations await publication reconciliation. Reviewed releases run as quality and capacity permit; public archives remain visible.

Company publication links: native verified links are listed separately from measured records. Adding a public link does not add views; new counters remain unknown until observed. All prior metric observation dates and totals are retained.
